title: Bash allow rules match a whole command line as a prefix
observed: MatchesRule compiled Bash(git *) to ^git .*$ over the whole line, so it approved "git status && rm -rf ~"; the prompt's own offered rule echo "=== * would have approved anything chained after an echo.
expected: Rules are judged per command segment; allow needs every segment, deny/ask any; substitutions are never allowed by a rule.

fix.note: Fixed in 7f8e470; regression test fails without the fix. Awaiting a live re-drive.
